KICwars

Five nations. One island. Command the war, or jump into the fight yourself.

How to play
  • Quick Battle: pick a unit and fight it yourself straight away. P reopens the unit chooser; when you die it comes back.
  • Fighting in person: just move the mouse to aim (no clicking). Space fires, E secondary, Q aim/scope, R reload, WASD move, X jump, C sprint, V first/third person, Alt frees the cursor, F back to commanding.
  • Planes: the jet follows your mouse. W/S throttle, A/D roll, Space guns, E missiles or bombs, R air-to-air missile (hold the nose on a jet until the tone goes solid), Z chaff when the MISSILE warning flashes.
  • Commanding: click or drag to select, right click (or Alt+click, two-finger tap, long press) to move or attack. WASD, screen edges or two-finger scroll pan; wheel or pinch zoom; Q E rotate.
  • Ctrl+1-9 make a group, 1-9 recall it. . finds an idle worker. Space jumps to the latest alert.
  • F1 all workers, F2 all ground troops, F3 all aircraft, F4 all ships. Tab opens the big map. Troops patrol by themselves around wherever you last sent them; Patrol area (U) picks a new beat.
  • With nothing selected, pick a building and place it: the nearest workers build it. Select your capital and press G for the War Room, J to send a scout. Right click a transport with infantry selected to board; B unloads.
  • New to the game? Press Tutorial on the main menu for a guided first battle.
  • Defences (More… in the build menu): Trenches, Sandbags and Pillboxes give infantry 55% cover. Select a finished building and press V to Harden it in concrete against artillery and air strikes.
  • Scouting: select the Capital, L sends a scout to any spot you click; in the War Room click the map table. F7 shows war statistics.
  • Diplomacy (F6): offer ceasefires, alliances, tribute and trades. Bots weigh your army, your gifts and their grudges.
  • Destroy every enemy capital to win, or end the war allied with everyone left. Lose yours and you are out.

Direct link not working? Use the GitHub relay

Slower (updates every few seconds, best for commanding, not flying), but it only talks to github.com. Each player needs their own GitHub token with only the gist scope: github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Tokens (classic) → Generate, tick only gist, expiry 7 days. Anyone holding it can create and edit your gists, so delete it after playing. It is kept only in this browser and only sent to api.github.com.

Joining through the GitHub relay

Your friend shares a relay room starting with G:. You need your own GitHub token with only the gist scope (github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Tokens (classic), tick only gist, 7 day expiry). It stays in this browser and is only sent to api.github.com. Delete it after playing.

Menu

The war keeps running.

Campaign

You get a budget. Buy troops, place them in your zone, then press Start and watch the battle. Wipe out the enemy army to unlock the next level.

FPS Battles

You are one soldier in a huge amphibious assault. Ride the landing craft in, fight up the beach and capture each objective in turn. Every soldier who lands costs a reinforcement ticket; run out and the assault fails. Capture objectives to land closer to the front.
